# 什么是搜索生成体验（SGE）？

- 原标题：What Is Search Generative Experience (SGE)?
- 作者：Flavio Amiel Roborank 创始人
- 原文更新日期：2026-07-15
- 原文：https://roborank.io/glossary/search-generative-experience/
- 栏目：[AI Search & GEO](https://roborank.io/ai-search/)
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。原文中的数据、观点、平台说明及推广内容均按原文保留，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

搜索生成体验（Search Generative Experience，SGE）是 Google 于 2023 年 5 月在 Search Labs 推出的实验性 AI 搜索界面。它在传统链接上方生成一个概括答案的 AI“快照”。SGE 以用户主动加入的测试形式运行，并于 2024 年 5 月转为正式的 AI Overviews，因此 SGE 这个名字如今基本属于历史称呼。

### 核心要点

- Google 于 2023 年 5 月 10 日在 Google I/O 推出 SGE，将其作为 Search Labs 中需要主动加入的实验，最初只面向美国英语用户。
- SGE 在结果页顶部生成 AI“快照”，综合多个来源，位于通常的蓝色链接上方。
- 2024 年 5 月 14 日，Google 向所有美国用户推出 AI Overviews，并称其为 Search Labs 实验的正式落地；SGE 实际上转变成了 AI Overviews。
- SGE 如今是历史术语：Google 当前文档和相关报道使用的是 AI Overviews 和 AI Mode，而不是 SGE。

### 搜索生成体验曾如何运作

搜索生成体验，是 Google 首次公开尝试在搜索结果页顶部放置生成式答案。查询触发它时，SGE 会生成一个 AI“快照”，也就是综合多个网络来源的简短概述，显示在熟悉的蓝色链接列表上方，并链接到所依据的页面。它没有取代结果页，而是在结果页前面加上答案，并让用户在快照下方以对话模式继续追问。

关键是，SGE 从未作为标准功能正式发布。Google 在 Search Labs 内运行它，后者是供用户自愿参加、测试早期搜索体验的项目，因此只有加入候补名单并启用它的用户，才会看到生成快照。这种实验定位是有意安排的：在向所有人开放之前，Google 能先收集准确性、来源引用和布局方面的反馈。对今天答案同样重要的[生成式引擎优化](https://roborank.io/glossary/generative-engine-optimization/)基础——能被 AI 爬虫检索、提供清楚且可引用的段落——也决定了页面能否进入 SGE 快照。

### 搜索生成体验示例

理解 SGE 最清楚的方式，是看它自己的时间线，Google 的公告对其有完整记录。Google 在 **2023 年 5 月 10 日的 Google I/O** 上，通过题为*《用生成式 AI 强化搜索》*的文章公布 SGE，并以需要主动加入的 Search Labs 实验形式推出，最初面向美国英语用户。此后大约一年，它一直是测试场景：用户必须自行启用，Google 则持续迭代快照外观、触发条件以及来源引用方式。

实验的结束不是关闭，而是正式落地。**2024 年 5 月 14 日**，在下一届 I/O 上，Google 宣布 AI Overviews 将开始向所有美国用户推出，并表示人们“已经通过 Search Labs 中的实验，使用 AI Overviews 数十亿次”；这里的实验指的就是 SGE。从那时起，SGE 这个名字实际上从 Google 自己的表述中消失，正式推出的功能改称 AI Overviews，后来更完整的对话式搜索场景则叫 AI Mode。因此，如今“SGE”最适合被理解为：现在的 [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/)在 2023–2024 年测试阶段的历史名称。

这一转变也收窄了功能的触发范围。在 Search Labs 时期，SGE 会为非常广泛的查询生成快照，包括许多总结并没有太大帮助的查询。到正式以 AI Overviews 推出时，Google 已将触发条件收回到综合答案真正有帮助的查询，并缩小了答案默认占用的纵向空间。这就是旧 SGE 截图会误导人的实际原因：2023 年人们针对其优化的界面，已不是今天内容在 Google 搜索中面对的界面。更名之后不变的，是底层交换条件：页面想进入答案，仍然必须可被 AI 爬虫访问，并提供足够清楚、可提取和引用的段落。

### 人们常犯的错误

我至今仍遇到这样的混淆：人们谈论“为 SGE 优化”，仿佛它是今天仍然存在、可以单独针对的产品。它不是。SGE 是实验的代号，真正推出的是 AI Overviews。它们是一条发展脉络，不是两个搜索场景；当功能离开 Search Labs 后，Google 就悄悄放弃了 SGE 名称。这很重要，因为追逐一年前的 SGE 截图和推出过程中的特殊表现会浪费精力：界面、触发条件和引用行为，在走向普遍可用的过程中都发生了变化。如果一份策略演示文稿仍然写着 SGE，应把它视为过时内容。如今真正要优化的是 AI Overviews，而完整延续下来的核心要求，是成为清楚、可引用的来源。

### 搜索生成体验与 AI Overviews

|  | 搜索生成体验（SGE） | AI Overviews |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **状态** | 已停用的实验名称 | 当前正式运行的功能 |
| **可用方式** | 通过 Search Labs 主动加入 | 广泛推出，默认开启 |
| **宣布时间** | Google I/O，2023 年 5 月 10 日 | Google I/O，2024 年 5 月 14 日 |
| **是什么** | 测试阶段 | 从实验转为正式的产品 |

它们不是竞争产品，而是同一件事的两个阶段：SGE 是 Search Labs 实验，AI Overviews 是 Google 面向公众推出后的形态。为 [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/)优化，把 SGE 当成背景历史。

### 常见问题

#### Google 的搜索生成体验是什么？

它是 Google 于 2023 年 5 月在 Search Labs 推出的实验性生成式 AI 搜索界面。它在普通搜索链接上方放置 AI 生成的答案“快照”，综合多个来源。它先作为自愿加入的测试运行，之后成为 AI Overviews。

#### SGE 和 AI Overviews 是同一个东西吗？

它们属于同一发展脉络。SGE 是 2023 年宣布的 Search Labs 实验版本，AI Overviews 是 Google 于 2024 年 5 月推出、普遍可用的版本。功能从测试转为正式时，Google 停用了 SGE 名称，因此今天产品叫 AI Overviews。

#### SGE 何时推出、何时结束？

Google 于 2023 年 5 月 10 日在 Google I/O 宣布 SGE，并向主动加入 Search Labs 的用户推出。2024 年 5 月 14 日，它转为公开发布的 AI Overviews，此时 SGE 这个称呼实际上停止使用。

#### 我还需要为 SGE 优化吗？

不需要再以这个名字为目标。SGE 已不作为独立产品存在，应改为针对 AI Overviews 优化。核心策略仍然延续：让 AI 爬虫能够访问，并提供清楚、可验证、可被引擎引用的段落，因为 AI Overviews 继承了 SGE 的引用驱动方式。

### 结论

SGE 是试验场，不是最终形态。它是用户主动加入的 Search Labs 实验，Google 在那里测试把生成式答案放到链接上方；大约一年后，这个理念以新名称 AI Overviews 面向所有人推出。了解 SGE 的主要价值在于理解历史：它解释了今天 Google 搜索中的 AI 答案从何而来。

## 英文原文

Search Generative Experience (SGE) was Google’s experimental AI-powered search interface, launched in Search Labs in May 2023, that generated an AI “snapshot” summarizing an answer above the traditional links. It ran as an opt-in test that Google graduated into AI Overviews in May 2024, so the SGE name is now largely historical.

### Key Takeaways

- Google introduced SGE at Google I/O on May 10, 2023, as an opt-in Search Labs experiment, initially limited to U.S. English users.
- SGE produced an AI-generated ‘snapshot’ at the top of the results page, drawing on multiple sources, sitting above the usual blue links.
- On May 14, 2024, Google launched AI Overviews to all U.S. users, describing it as the graduation of the Search Labs experiment — SGE effectively became AI Overviews.
- The term SGE is now historical: current Google documentation and coverage refer to AI Overviews and AI Mode, not SGE.

### How Search Generative Experience Worked

Search Generative Experience was Google’s first public attempt to put a generated answer at the top of its results page. When a query triggered it, SGE produced an AI “snapshot” — a short synthesized summary drawn from multiple web sources — displayed above the familiar list of blue links, with links out to the pages it drew on. It did not replace the results page; it prepended an answer to it, and let users ask follow-up questions in a conversational mode below the snapshot.

Crucially, SGE never shipped as a standard feature. Google ran it inside Search Labs, its opt-in program for testing early-stage Search experiences, so only users who joined the waitlist and enabled it saw the generated snapshots. That experimental framing was deliberate: it let Google gather feedback on accuracy, sourcing, and layout before exposing the feature to everyone. The same [generative engine optimization](https://roborank.io/glossary/generative-engine-optimization/) fundamentals that matter for today’s answers — being retrievable by AI crawlers and supplying clean, citable passages — are what determined whether a page was drawn into an SGE snapshot.

### Example of Search Generative Experience

The clearest way to see SGE is through its own timeline, which is fully documented in Google’s announcements. Google unveiled SGE at **Google I/O on May 10, 2023**, in a post titled *“Supercharging Search with generative AI,”* and rolled it out as an opt-in Search Labs experiment starting in U.S. English. For roughly a year it remained a test surface: users had to enable it, and Google iterated on how the snapshot looked, what triggered it, and how it cited sources.

The experiment ended by graduating, not by shutting down. On **May 14, 2024**, at the following year’s I/O, Google announced that AI Overviews would begin rolling out to everyone in the U.S., noting that people had “already used AI Overviews billions of times through our experiment in Search Labs” — the experiment being SGE. From that point the SGE name effectively disappeared from Google’s own language, replaced by AI Overviews for the launched feature and, later, AI Mode for the fuller conversational surface. So “SGE” today is best read as the historical label for the 2023–2024 test phase of what is now [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/).

The transition also narrowed the feature. In the Search Labs era, SGE fired a generated snapshot for a very wide range of queries, including many where a summary added little; by the time it shipped as AI Overviews, Google had pulled the triggering back toward queries where a synthesized answer genuinely helped, and shrank how much vertical space the answer occupied by default. That is the practical reason old SGE screenshots mislead — the surface people optimized against in 2023 is not the one their content meets in Google Search today. What survived the rename unchanged is the underlying bargain: to be drawn into the answer, a page still has to be reachable by an AI crawler and offer a passage clean enough to lift and cite.

### The thing people get wrong

The confusion I still run into is people talking about "optimizing for SGE" as if it were a live, separate product you can target today. It isn’t. SGE was the codename for the experiment; AI Overviews is what shipped. They are the same lineage, not two surfaces, and Google quietly dropped the SGE label once the feature left Search Labs. This matters because chasing year-old SGE screenshots and rollout quirks wastes effort — the interface, the triggering, and the citation behavior all changed on the way to general availability. If a strategy deck still says SGE, treat it as dated. The thing you actually optimize for now is AI Overviews, and the underlying discipline — being a clean, citable source — is what carried over intact.

### Search Generative Experience vs AI Overviews

|  | Search Generative Experience (SGE) | AI Overviews |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Status** | Retired experimental name | Current live feature |
| **Availability** | Opt-in via Search Labs | Rolled out broadly, on by default |
| **Announced** | Google I/O, May 10, 2023 | Google I/O, May 14, 2024 |
| **What it is** | The test phase | The graduated product |

They are not competing products but two stages of one thing: SGE was the Search Labs experiment, and AI Overviews is what it became once Google launched it to the public. Optimize for [AI Overviews](https://roborank.io/glossary/ai-overviews/); treat SGE as the backstory.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What was Google's Search Generative Experience?

It was Google’s experimental generative-AI search interface, launched in Search Labs in May 2023. It placed an AI-generated ‘snapshot’ summarizing an answer above the normal search links, drawing on multiple sources. It ran as an opt-in test before becoming AI Overviews.

#### Is SGE the same as AI Overviews?

They are the same lineage. SGE was the experimental Search Labs version announced in 2023; AI Overviews is the generally available version Google launched in May 2024. Google retired the SGE name when the feature graduated from testing, so today the product is called AI Overviews.

#### When did SGE launch and when did it end?

Google announced SGE at Google I/O on May 10, 2023, and rolled it out to Search Labs opt-in users. It transitioned to the publicly launched AI Overviews on May 14, 2024, at which point the SGE label was effectively discontinued.

#### Do I still need to optimize for SGE?

Not under that name. SGE no longer exists as a separate product; optimize for AI Overviews instead. The core tactics carry over — be reachable by AI crawlers and supply clean, verifiable passages an engine can quote — since AI Overviews inherited SGE’s citation-driven approach.

### The Bottom Line

SGE was the proving ground, not the destination. It was the opt-in Search Labs experiment where Google tested putting a generated answer above its links, and after roughly a year it shipped that idea to everyone under a new name — AI Overviews. Understanding SGE is mostly useful as history: it explains where today’s AI answers in Google Search came from.
